create_DropPath_module: create a DropPath module with a specified drop probability for stochastic depth regularization
use_drop_path_function: use the drop_path function to randomly drop entire sample paths during training
apply_stochastic_depth: apply stochastic depth to residual blocks by wrapping them with the DropPath module
configure_drop_probability: configure the drop probability parameter in DropPath to control regularization strength
run_drop_path_inference: run the DropPath module during inference where it passes inputs through unchanged
